title: SIYAYO Academy Verb Schema
description: Schema for lexical verb corpora used by the SIYAYO Academy Built-in Actions system.

lemma.description: Base form of the English lexical verb.

verbFunction.description: Semantic function or functions expressed by the verb. This axis is independent from morphological regularity.

verbClass.description: Optional pedagogical usage/system labels. Do not use this field as a substitute for verbFunction or regularity.

regularity.description: English lexical morphology classification used by the current Built-in Actions corpus. In the Simple Past affirmative, regular verbs normally use an -ed form while irregular verbs use a stored irregular past form. This value must not be treated as a universal EN/ES/PT classification; morphology is language-specific. With English DID in negative and interrogative Simple Past forms, the lexical verb returns to its base form regardless of this classification.

forms.description: Stored English lexical forms. These forms describe the English lemma and do not define Spanish or Portuguese morphology.
